|ISBN=978-1-59020-730-7 |page=209 |author-link=Hiroaki Sato (translator)}}</ref> Katsuyori's children included Takeda Nobukatsu and Katsuchika.<ref name="harimaya.com">{{Cite web|url=http://www2.harimaya.com/sengoku/html/takeda.html|title=兵庫県西部、播磨地方の情報を中心に日本の旅の想い出を発信しています|language=Japanese|website=www2.harimaya.com}}</ref>

Katsuyori, first known as {{nihongo|'''Suwa Shirō Katsuyori'''|諏訪四郎勝頼}}, succeeded to his mother's {{ill|Suwa clan|de|Suwa (Klan)|fa|خاندان سووا|fr|Clan Suwa|id|Klan Suwa|it|Clan Suwa|ja|諏訪氏|ko|스와씨|pt|Clã Suwa|ru|Сува (род)|qid=Q2975376|lt=Suwa clan}} and gained Takatō Castle as the seat of his domain.

After his elder brother {{ill|Takeda Yoshinobu|ar|تاكيدا يوشينوبو|de|Takeda Yoshinobu|fa|تاکدا یوشینوبو|fr|Takeda Yoshinobu|ja|武田義信|vi|Takeda Yoshinobu|zh|武田義信|qid=Q837273|lt=Takeda Yoshinobu}} died, Katsuyori's son Nobukatsu became heir to the Takeda clan, making Katsuyori the ''de facto'' ruler of the Takeda clan.<ref name="battles">{{cite book |last1=Turnbull |first1=Stephen |title=Battles of the Samurai |date=1987 |publisher=Arms and Armour Press |isbn=978-0-85368-826-6 |location=London |pages=79–94}}</ref> Takeda Katsuyori built {{ill|Shinpu Castle|fa|قلعه شینپو|ja|新府城|qid=Q11502234|lt=Shinpu Castle}}, a new and larger castle at Nirasaki and transferred his residence there in 1581.

==Military life==
In 1569, Katsuyori defeated [[Hojo Ujinobu]] at {{ill|Siege of Kanbara|fa|محاصره کانبارا|fr|Siège du château de Kanbara|it|Assedio di Kanbara|nl|Beleg van Kanbara|qid=Q2659520|lt=Siege of Kanbara}}<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.jalan.net/kankou/spt_22382af2170020709/ |title=蒲原城|publisher=じゃらん|language=ja|access-date=25 July 2019}}</ref>

In 1572, Katsuyori successfully took a {{ill|Tokugawa clan|ar|عشيرة توكوغاوا|arz|عشيرة توكوجاوا|ast|Clan Tokugawa|cs|Klan Tokugawa|de|Tokugawa|eo|Tokugawa (klano)|es|Clan Tokugawa|eu|Tokugawa klana|fa|خاندان توکوگاوا|fr|Clan Tokugawa|frr|Tokugawa|hr|Tokugawa|hu|Tokugava család|hy|Տոկուգավա կլան|id|Klan Tokugawa|is|Tokugawa-ættin|it|Clan Tokugawa|ja|徳川氏|ko|도쿠가와씨|ms|Puak Tokugawa|nl|Tokugawa|no|Tokugawa-klanen|pl|Tokugawa (ród)|pt|Clã Tokugawa|ru|Токугава (род)|th|ตระกูลโทกูงาวะ|tr|Tokugawa boyu|uk|Рід Токуґава|vi|Gia tộc Tokugawa|zh|德川氏|zh_min_nan|Tokugawa--sī|qid=Q1412769|lt=Tokugawa clan}} possession in the {{ill|Siege of Futamata|azb|فوتاماتا موحاصیره‌سی|fa|محاصره قلعه فوتاماتا|fr|Siège de Futamata|it|Assedio di Futamata|ja|二俣城の戦い|nl|Beleg van Futamata|zh|二俁城之戰|qid=Q1014528|lt=Siege of Futamata}}, and participated in the {{ill|Battle of Mikatagahara|azb|میکاتاقاهارا دؤیوشو|ca|Batalla de Mikatagahara|cs|Bitva u Mikatagahary|da|Slaget ved Mikatagahara|eo|Batalo de Mikatagahara|es|Batalla de Mikatagahara|fa|نبرد میکاتاگاهارا|fi|Mikatagaharan taistelu|fr|Bataille de Mikata-Ga-Hara|he|קרב מיקאטגהרה|it|Battaglia di Mikatagahara|ja|三方ヶ原の戦い|ko|미카타가하라 전투|mn|Микатагахарагийн тулалдаан|nl|Slag bij Mikatagahara|ru|Битва при Микатагахаре|sk|Bitka pri Mikata ga Hare|sr|Битка код Микатагахаре|th|ยุทธการที่มิกาตางาฮาระ|tr|Mikatagahara Muharebesi|uk|Битва при Мікатаґахара|vi|Trận Mikatagahara|zh|三方原之戰|qid=Q690464|lt=Battle of Mikatagahara}} against the Oda-Tokugawa alliance.<ref name="Turnbull2">{{Cite book |last=Turnbull |first=Stephen |title=The Samurai Sourcebook |publisher=Cassell & Co. |year=1998 |ISBN=1-85409-523-4 |page=219,222–223,230}}</ref>

In 1573, Katsuyori took charge of the Takeda family after the death of Shingen and fought the {{ill|Tokugawa clan|ar|عشيرة توكوغاوا|arz|عشيرة توكوجاوا|ast|Clan Tokugawa|cs|Klan Tokugawa|de|Tokugawa|eo|Tokugawa (klano)|es|Clan Tokugawa|eu|Tokugawa klana|fa|خاندان توکوگاوا|fr|Clan Tokugawa|frr|Tokugawa|hr|Tokugawa|hu|Tokugava család|hy|Տոկուգավա կլան|id|Klan Tokugawa|is|Tokugawa-ættin|it|Clan Tokugawa|ja|徳川氏|ko|도쿠가와씨|ms|Puak Tokugawa|nl|Tokugawa|no|Tokugawa-klanen|pl|Tokugawa (ród)|pt|Clã Tokugawa|ru|Токугава (род)|th|ตระกูลโทกูงาวะ|tr|Tokugawa boyu|uk|Рід Токуґава|vi|Gia tộc Tokugawa|zh|德川氏|zh_min_nan|Tokugawa--sī|qid=Q1412769|lt=Tokugawa clan}}.

In 1574, he {{ill|Siege of Takatenjin (1574)|fr|Siège de Takatenjin (1574)|it|Assedio di Takatenjin (1574)|nl|Beleg van Takatenjin (1574)|qid=Q4540826|lt=captured Takatenjin castle}}, which even his father had not managed to do. This gained him the support of other members of the Takeda clan.

In 1575, he suffered a terrible loss at the {{ill|Battle of Nagashino|ar|معركة ناغاشينو|azb|ناقاشینو دؤیوشو|ca|Batalla de Nagashino|de|Schlacht von Nagashino|eo|Batalo de Nagashino|es|Batalla de ==Death==
{{Main|Battle of Tenmokuzan}}
After Katsuyori {{ill|Siege of Takatenjin (1581)|azb|تاکاتنجین موحاصیره‌سی (۱۵۸۱)|fa|محاصره تاکاتنجین (۱۵۸۱)|fr|Siège de Takatenjin (1581)|it|Assedio di Takatenjin (1581)|nl|Beleg van Takatenjin (1581)|qid=Q2275430|lt=lost Takatenjin fortress}} and {{ill|Siege of Takatō (1582)|azb|تاکاتو محاصیره‌سی (۱۵۸۲)|es|Asedio de Takatō (1582)|fa|محاصره قلعه تاکاتوئو (۱۵۸۲)|fr|Siège de Takatō (1582)|it|Assedio di Takatō (1582)|ja|高遠城の戦い|ko|다카토성 전투 (1582년)|nl|Beleg van Takato (1582)|sr|Опсада замка Такато|qid=Q2901847|lt=Takatō castle}}, many clans like Kiso and Anayama withdrew their support for Takeda. The Oda-Tokugawa alliance advanced into {{ill|Kai Province|ckb|پارێزگای کای|cs|Provincie Kai|de|Provinz Kai|eo|Provinco Kai|es|Provincia de Kai|eu|Kai probintzia|fa|ولایت کای|fi|Kain provinssi|fr|Province de Kai|gl|Provincia de Kai|id|Provinsi Kai|it|Kai (provincia)|ja|甲斐国|ko|가이국|lt|Kajaus žemė|ms|Wilayah Kai|nl|Kai (provincie)|pt|Província de Kai|ru|Каи (провинция)|simple|Kai Province|sk|Kai (provincia)|sr|Провинција Каи|tr|Kai (vilayet)|uk|Провінція Кай|wuu|甲斐国|zh|甲斐國|zh_min_nan|Kai-kok|zh_yue|甲斐國|qid=Q858076|lt=Kai Province}}, and laid siege to {{ill|Shinpu Castle|fa|قلعه شینپو|ja|新府城|qid=Q11502234|lt=Shinpu Castle}}, Katsuyori was unable to hold the castle with his remaining 300-400 men, so he set fire to Shinpu Castle and fled into the Tenmoku mountain. Later, his forces were destroyed by the combined armies of {{ill|Oda Nobunaga|af|Oda Nobunaga|ar|أودا نوبوناغا|arz|اودا نوبوناجا|ast|Oda Nobunaga|az|Oda Nobunaqa|ban|Oda Nobunaga|bcl|Oda === Toyama Fujin ===
Takeda Katsuyori married Toyoma Fujin, the adopted daughter of {{ill|Oda Nobunaga|af|Oda Nobunaga|ar|أودا نوبوناغا|arz|اودا نوبوناجا|ast|Oda Nobunaga|az|Oda Nobunaqa|ban|Oda Nobunaga|bcl|Oda Nobunaga|be|Ода Набунага|bg|Ода Нобунага|bs|Oda Nobunaga|ca|Oda Nobunaga|cdo|Cék-dièng Séng-diòng|ckb|ئۆدا نۆبوناگا|cs|Nobunaga Oda|da|Oda Nobunaga|de|Oda Nobunaga|el|Όντα Νομπουνάγκα|eo|Oda Nobunaga|es|Oda Nobunaga|et|Oda Nobunaga|eu|Oda Nobunaga|fa|اودا نوبوناگا|fi|Oda Nobunaga|fr|Oda Nobunaga|gl|Oda Nobunaga|glk|اؤدا نؤبۊناگا|hak|Oda Nobunaga|he|אודה נובונאגה|hr|Oda Nobunaga|hu|Oda Nobunaga|id|Oda Nobunaga|is|Oda Nobunaga|it|Oda Nobunaga|ja|織田信長|ka|ოდა ნობუნაგა|kk|Ода Нобунага|ko|오다 노부나가|kw|Oda Nobunaga|la|Nobunanga|lt|Oda Nobunaga|lv|Oda Nobunaga|mg|Oda Nobunaga|mn|Ода Нобүнага|ms|Oda Nobunaga|nl|Oda Nobunaga|no|Oda Nobunaga|oc|Oda Nobunaga|pam|Nobunaga Oda|pl|Nobunaga Oda|pt|Oda Nobunaga|ro|Nobunaga Oda|ru|Ода Нобунага|sc|Oda Nobunaga|sh|Nobunaga Oda|simple|Oda Nobunaga|sk|Nobunaga Oda|sq|Oda Nobunaga|sr|Ода Нобунага|su|Oda Nobunaga|sv|Oda Nobunaga|tg|Ода Набунага|th|โอดะ โนบูนางะ|tl|Oda Nobunaga|tr|Oda Nobunaga|uk|Ода Нобунаґа|ur|اودا نوبوناگا|vi|Oda Nobunaga|war|Oda Nobunaga|wuu|织田信长|xmf|ოდა ნობუნაგა|zh|織田信長|zh_classical|織田信長|zh_min_nan|Oda Nobunaga|zh_yue|織田信長|zu|Oda Nobunaga|qid=Q171411|lt=Oda Nobunaga}}. She died while giving birth to their son Nobukatsu in 1567.

=== Keirin'in ===
Katsuyori later married Keirin'in, daughter of {{ill|Hōjō Ujiyasu|cs|Udžijasu Hódžó|de|Hōjō Ujiyasu|es|Hōjō Ujiyasu|fa|هوجو اوجی‌یاسو|fr|Hōjō Ujiyasu|it|Hōjō Ujiyasu|ja|北条氏康|ko|호조 우지야스|nl|Hojo Ujiyasu|pl|Ujiyasu Hōjō|pt|Hōjō Ujiyasu|ru|Ходзё Удзиясу|sk|Udžijasu Hódžó|tr|Hōjō Ujiyasu|uk|Ходзьо Удзіясу|wuu|北条氏康|zh|北條氏康|zu|Hōjō Ujiyasu|qid=Q943643|lt=Hojo Ujiyasu}}. They had a son and two daughters. In 1582, when Keirin'in was 19, Katsuyori was decisively defeated by Oda Nobunaga, and they had to flee. However, Katsuyori was resigned to die and urged her to leave him. She refused and killed herself (''[[:en:Jigai|Jigai]]''), along with Katsuyori in the {{ill|Battle of Tenmokuzan|azb|تنموکوزان دؤیوشو|br|Emgann Tenmokuzan|eo|Batalo de Temmokuzan|es|Batalla de Tenmokuzan|eu|Temmokuzango gudua|fa|نبرد تنموکوزان|fr|Bataille de Tenmokuzan|it|Battaglia di Tenmokuzan|ja|天目山の戦い|ko|덴모쿠산 전투|nl|Slag bij Temmokuzan|sr|Битка код села Тано|qid=Q1113509|lt=Battle of Tenmokuzan}}. Both of his sons died in the battle.
